title: eCoA result record
description: One measured result from one certificate. The unit of extraction is a result and its limit together, because a value only means anything next to the limit it is judged against — separating them is what let a mould count of 4,2 x 10^4 sit in a register as 4.2x10^3 and read as passing.

certificate.description: Code exactly as printed, e.g. '320/0587/25'. Cyrillic and Latin homoglyphs are preserved here verbatim; normalisation belongs in the lookup key, not the record.

certificate_key.description: Normalised lookup form: homoglyphs folded to Latin, separators stripped, Farmahem '-LoD-' mapped to GS. '197-1-К/26' and '197-1-K-26' both key to 1971K26.

batch.description: Batch as printed on the certificate.

batch_key.description: From ingestion/common/batch_id.py::batch_key — the single batch-identity definition in this repository. GG1024/01 and GG1024_01 key alike; GG1024_01/01 stays distinct from its parent.

p_number.description: Filenames key on the P-number while the register keys on the strain-batch code. Carrying both is what makes reconciliation resolve on the first pass.

lab.description: IJZ Institute of Public Health, -MB its microbiology department; CNP UKIM Center for Natural Products; FHM Farmahem; NGP New Garden Pharma; DFL State Phytosanitary Laboratory; PP in-house.

parameter.description: Canonical parameter. OTHER is permitted only for doc_class B or C, where the parameter set is not known in advance.

parameter_printed.description: Verbatim label, e.g. 'Вкупен број габи и мувли-ТYMC'. The corpus writes this as ТУМС, ТYMC and TUMC for the same parameter; keeping it verbatim is how that stays auditable.

value.description: The measurement as a NUMBER. 4,2 x 10^4 is stored as 42000.0. The exponent is resolved here, once, so nothing downstream ever has to read a superscript again — which is the single change that would have prevented this whole class of error. null only when operator is 'absent' or 'not_tested'.

value_printed.description: Verbatim, glyphs intact: '4,2 x 10⁴ CFU/g'. This is what a human checks the machine against.

operator.description: '< 10 CFU/g' is not 10. Results are also printed as bounded ranges — '< 10^4 и > 10^3' — which is a range, not a point.

limit.description: The limit printed on THIS certificate, as a number. Captured per result, never inherited from a column header: 1220/2171/25 prints TYMC <= 10^2 where the register's column says 10^4, so its result of 200 fails on the paper and passes against the column.

verdict_printed.description: The laboratory's own conclusion, verbatim — ОДГОВАРА or НЕ ОДГОВАРА. Recorded as a CLAIM, never as the disposition. Ten certificates in this corpus concluded ОДГОВАРА over their own failing number.

doc_class.description: A templated (IJZ/CNP/FHM, same table every time) — strict schema, two reads must agree. B non-standard (NGP, DFL, in-house QCCoA, NO-DOC-CODE reports) — open parameter set, human sign-off required. C scanned with no usable text layer — B plus a stored page image.

confidence.description: 'review' is forced for every doc_class B and C record: with no fixed layout there is nothing to validate the shape against, so a person confirms before the record is trusted.

reads_agree.description: Two independent vision reads agreed on every numeric field. false means neither value was stored and the page was raised — a second read costs far less than a missed out-of-specification batch.

flag.description: Set at ingest by the R1/R2 rules in validate_ecoa_limits.py. 'over_limit' is written, never suppressed. 'one_decade_below_limit' is the exact shape a misread 10^4->10^3 leaves behind and is the only shape that silently turns a fail into a pass.

page_image.description: Rendered page kept for doc_class C, so the paper is always one click away.

model_chain.description: Models used, in order tried. Per AGENT_MODEL_POLICY.md; classical OCR is forbidden and policy_check.py rule 1 enforces it.
